description: This Java source file defines the class MidiOutputPortSelector, which manages user selection of MIDI output ports in an Android application. It extends MidiPortSelector and handles opening MIDI devices, selecting output ports, and providing a MidiSender for sending MIDI messages.

classes.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
classes.description: A class that manages user selection of MIDI output ports, handles device opening, port connection, and provides a MidiSender for sending MIDI messages.

methods.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the selector with the MIDI manager, activity context, and spinner ID.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when a user selects a MIDI port, opens the device, and connects the port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Performs cleanup by disconnecting and closing the MIDI port and device.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the MidiSender associated with the selected MIDI port to send MIDI messages.
